current_limitation: One hero image pair; no slide blocks, navigation, swipe or autoplay controls.
possible_later_action: Add a slideshow section or extend Hero with editable slide blocks; retain the current single-image option.

current_limitation: The content panel always has markup, even when its text and buttons are cleared. No show/hide panel setting exists. This causes duplicated content over an already designed banner.
possible_later_action: Add an image-only/content-overlay switch; preserve accessible text and real clickable links.

current_limitation: Minimum height is set inline but !important CSS replaces it: 300px and 800px selections both computed to 648px at 1440×900 and 680px at 390×900.
possible_later_action: Connect desktop/mobile height controls to the final responsive CSS.

current_limitation: On mobile, panel colour/opacity, content width and text alignment are constrained by fixed CSS. Opacity 0 and 100 both computed to the same 92% ivory background at 390px. Desktop opacity worked. At widths ≤380px the heading-size choices are also overridden by a fixed 31px font size.
possible_later_action: Respect the existing settings or expose separate mobile panel controls.

current_limitation: The mobile image is used only inside the desktop-image branch. Selecting only a mobile image still displays demo images. The current export has a desktop image selected and no separate mobile image.
possible_later_action: Allow a mobile-only selection with a defined desktop fallback.

current_limitation: Hero has no whole-image destination, image-only link, fit-to-image mode or crop-mode selector. Collection Banner has no separate mobile image. A button painted into an image is not an actual link.
possible_later_action: Add the required image/link/fit controls when implementing the slideshow.

current_limitation: Built-in navigation has seven fixed titles and handles. With Use built-in menu enabled, the selected native Shopify Menu is ignored by design. This export has built-in mode enabled.
possible_later_action: Already editable: disable Use built-in menu in Header, then select the menu managed in Shopify Content → Menus.

current_limitation: Text logo fallback is assigned to logo_text but never displayed. A built-in Gujju Jewels image is displayed instead when no logo is selected.
possible_later_action: Render the text setting as a selectable fallback; retain image upload options.

current_limitation: Desktop/mobile background and divider fields generate variables, but later CSS uses global palette variables. Red/green backgrounds and a blue divider were not reflected at either tested width.
possible_later_action: Use the header-specific variables in the final style rules.

current_limitation: The mobile built-in image has a fixed responsive clamp instead of mobile_logo_width. Uploaded logos have width controls; the desktop built-in image is height-constrained.
possible_later_action: Make the built-in sizing policy explicit or connect it to the existing width fields.

feature: Header layout and mobile account icon
current_limitation: No logo-alignment or search/cart visibility controls. The account icon is hidden in the mobile header by CSS even if Show account is enabled; the account link is available in the mobile menu when accounts are enabled.
possible_later_action: Add layout controls only if desired; account authentication remains Shopify-managed.

current_limitation: Both fields appear in the editor and are assigned, but neither is rendered. Synthetic menu links for these two fields never appeared in the output.
possible_later_action: Render the selected menus and their headings.

current_limitation: Shop and Help & Support headings and the base links are fixed. Menu 1 only appends up to four links and excludes a link titled Search. New Arrivals and Trending Picks target fixed homepage anchors.
possible_later_action: Use editable menu columns and heading settings while preserving dynamic Shopify policy links.

current_limitation: Heading and description are editable, but there is no newsletter visibility toggle. Subscribe, success text and the copyright suffix are literal strings. Clearing the heading does not remove the form.
possible_later_action: Add a visibility field and use locale keys or appropriate text settings.

current_limitation: JavaScript transforms footer navigation into closed disclosures on product pages at widths ≤989px. No accordion toggle, breakpoint or default-open control exists.
possible_later_action: Expose a control if this behaviour needs merchant configuration; preserve the current default.

current_limitation: The category-level Button label is rendered but the shop-link element is hidden on every viewport. Image/title links still function; the section-level bottom button is separate.
possible_later_action: Add a show-category-button control or make the existing label visible.

current_limitation: Category media is forced circular with a fixed size cap; no circle/square/aspect-ratio setting. Desktop columns are configurable; mobile/tablet grid changes are prescribed by CSS.
possible_later_action: Expose shape and mobile-column options only if required.

current_limitation: No post blocks means six built-in demo photos are shown on the storefront. There is no show-demo switch. The gallery is manual content, not a connected Instagram feed.
possible_later_action: Add an empty-state/demo toggle; actual images/captions/links are already editable post blocks.

current_limitation: Changing overlay opacity from 10 to 80 still yields a transparent overlay because its background is forced transparent.
possible_later_action: Restore an actual overlay colour and respect opacity.

current_limitation: Main Product has settings but no component blocks. Gallery/vendor/title/price/quantity/options/cart/details order cannot be rearranged individually; no @app block support in Main Product. Separate template sections can be managed in the editor.
possible_later_action: Convert only the required product components into editable blocks; preserve product-form logic.

current_limitation: Four offer texts are editable, but the maximum count and percentage icon are fixed. Clearing a text hides that offer; no Add offer block supports a fifth.
possible_later_action: Use offer blocks if flexible count/icons are needed. These messages do not create discounts or gifts.

current_limitation: Three benefit titles/subtexts are editable. The maximum count and return/shipping/COD icon assignments are fixed.
possible_later_action: Use benefit blocks if flexible count/icons are needed.

current_limitation: Disabling the expanded product details shows three fixed strings: Secure checkout, Carefully packed and Customer support.
possible_later_action: Expose text fields only if retaining this fallback.

current_limitation: Description open/closed is configurable; Shipping & Returns and product FAQ default-open behaviour is fixed. Policy content is drawn from Shopify policies or the shipping text setting.
possible_later_action: Add default-open controls if desired; policy content does not need hardcoding.

current_limitation: No editor switches for second-image hover, quick add, Sale/Sold Out badges or savings display. Card wording is mostly literal English. Product titles/photos/prices/availability themselves come from Shopify products.
possible_later_action: Add product-card switches and locale keys while keeping native product/variant data.

current_limitation: show_quick_add:false and lazy_load:false are overridden by Liquid default:true. Local rendering confirmed quick add and lazy loading remained enabled. Current callers use the defaults, so this is a latent configuration defect.
possible_later_action: Preserve explicit false values before exposing these options.

current_limitation: Enable, heading, subheading, fallback collection and count are editable. Count is 1–10. Responsive columns and recommendation-loading behaviour are fixed; no theme product-list picker for individual related products.
possible_later_action: No count change needed. Add layout/product-selection controls only if requested; Shopify supplies recommendation results.

current_limitation: Collection and product count are editable (2–16), as are desktop columns (2–5). No direct product_list picker or section sort-mode field. New Arrivals sorts all-product fallback by publication date only when no collection is selected; a selected collection uses its order. View All wording has a fixed prefix.
possible_later_action: Use an ordered Shopify collection now; add individual selection/sort/text controls only if required.

current_limitation: Inter and Cormorant Garamond are loaded explicitly; there is no font_picker setting. Font-size settings already exist.
possible_later_action: Add body/heading font pickers and connect loading/CSS to them.

current_limitation: Section-specific spacing overrides global spacing. Some mobile section padding is capped at 72px. Category circles and product panels override radius defaults; product panels have a minimum 12px radius.
possible_later_action: Document intended overrides or add separate mobile/component controls.

current_limitation: Main Cart has an empty settings array. Headings, labels, empty-state text, arrow arrangement and checkout wording are code-defined. Quantity arrows and autosave exist; no Update Cart button is rendered.
possible_later_action: Expose labels/layout only if desired; preserve existing quantity/checkout behaviour.

current_limitation: Fixed headings/placeholders, product-only search, 24 results per page and four-column desktop grid. No merchant controls for these choices.
possible_later_action: Add appropriate text, result-count and layout settings; broader search requires matching result rendering.

current_limitation: Blog listing uses 12 articles per page, three columns, a 180-character excerpt and literal Read more. Blog/article content is editable in Shopify; template layout is fixed.
possible_later_action: Add layout/display controls only when needed.

current_limitation: Name/Email/Phone/Message fields, required email/message, Send message and success wording are fixed. Page title/body remain editable Shopify page content.
possible_later_action: Add configurable field/label options while preserving Shopify contact form processing.

current_limitation: 404 content, Previous/Next, collection toolbar labels, price accessibility text and quick-add status messages are largely literal strings rather than locale keys. Editing default theme content cannot change literals.
possible_later_action: Move customer-facing strings into locales; use section text settings where appropriate.

current_limitation: Announcement, header and footer are static section calls in the layout rather than section groups. Homepage template sections can be reordered; the header/footer areas cannot be freely composed into groups.
possible_later_action: Use section groups only if flexible header/footer composition is required.

current_limitation: custom-footer.liquid is a separate older Footer with different controls/fallback imagery. The active layout uses footer.liquid. Editing or adding the legacy section will not control the live static footer.
possible_later_action: Keep this distinction visible; consolidate only in a later explicitly scoped change.

current_limitation: Product image swapping, variant price/availability sync, cart request handling, mobile drawers, breakpoint thresholds and retry timings are implemented in JavaScript/CSS without merchant fields. No slideshow, predictive-search interface or review submission backend is present.
possible_later_action: These are implementation details, not automatically missing Shopify features. Expose only the behaviours the merchant needs to configure.
